target_objects: ow-tp-portal-<ns>-authorizer (Lambda python3.12 REQUEST authorizer on the HTTP API; every route except GET /health requires it)
ow-tp-portal-<ns>-token-authorizer (API Gateway v2 authorizer, simple responses, Authorization identity source)
ow-tp-portal-<ns>-demo-site-waf (WAFv2 CLOUDFRONT web ACL: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet + rate-based rule)
ow-tp-portal-<ns>-demo-site CloudFront distribution (WAF-attached CDN over the S3 demo page)
ow-tp-portal-<ns>-<context> live alias weighted routing (canary; Terraform ignores alias drift so canary shifts never fight apply)
ow-tp-portal-<ns>-alarm-to-devin (EventBridge rule on CloudWatch Alarm State Change, ALARM only) -> ow-tp-portal-<ns>-devin-webhook (connection + API destination)
ow-tp-portal-<ns>-budget (AWS Budgets monthly guardrail on user:Project$otterworks-tp) + ow-tp-portal-<ns>-budget-alerts (SNS)
golden_baseline_location: scripts/tp_portal/golden/portal-golden-transcript.json (unchanged; parity is judged with credentials attached via transcript.py --token, never via an exemption)

acceptance_checks.description: A request without an Authorization header to any non-health route is rejected with 401 (the header is the authorizer's identity source, so API Gateway rejects before invoking anything).
A request with a wrong bearer token is rejected with 403 (authorizer returns isAuthorized=false under simple responses).
The 20-step golden transcript replay passes 20/20 with the demo bearer token attached to every request (transcript.py --token / PORTAL_API_TOKEN).
The demo token is generated by Terraform (random_password) and surfaced only as the sensitive output demo_api_token; no plaintext credential is committed anywhere.
canary.py deploy with a healthy jar holds the alias at (1-w) stable / w canary for the bake window, then promotes to 100% canary when the gate alarms (per-context errors + api-5xx) stay OK.
canary.py deploy with CHAOS_FAULT=invoke-error restores the alias to 100% stable automatically as soon as a gate alarm enters ALARM; the operator does nothing (exit code 2).

The per-context error alarms, api-5xx, and async alarms are matched by the alarm-to-devin EventBridge rule (state=ALARM only, i.e. once per OK->ALARM transition) targeting the Devin webhook API destination with the sensitive auth header held in the EventBridge connection.
load_test.py drives the pinned profile (portal-load-v1: 5-request read mix, fixed workers/duration) and reports requests, throughput_rps, p50/p95/p99, error count and error_rate as JSON.

AWS Budgets monthly limit on the estate tag with 80% actual and 100% forecasted notifications to the estate SNS topic; toggleable via enable_budget_guardrail when the applying principal lacks budgets permissions.

planted_anomalies.description: A canary published with CHAOS_FAULT=invoke-error must fail every invocation as an invocation error (Errors metric increments), trip the gate alarm, and be rolled back automatically.
A syntactically valid but incorrect bearer token must be denied (403), including prefix/superstring variants of the real token (constant-time comparison).

WAF rule evaluation, CloudFront serving, rate-limit shedding, real alarm OK->ALARM transitions, EventBridge API-destination delivery to the Devin webhook, and AWS Budgets evaluation are live-only behaviors.
planted_anomalies.reason: Fixture (child) runs never touch live AWS; the parent proves these in the live validation window. The fixture proves the authorizer decision logic, the gateway 401/403 semantics via the shim front door, and the auth-enabled 20/20 replay.

encoding_policy.input_encoding: Unchanged from the decompose unit: UTF-8 JSON bodies; base64 API Gateway payloads decoded strictly as UTF-8; percent-decoded path segments ('+' literal). The Authorization header is ASCII 'Bearer <token>' with a token from [A-Za-z0-9]{40}.
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Not byte-transparent: replay parity remains parsed-JSON comparison with timestamp normalization; auth adds a request header and must not change any response body. 401/403 rejection bodies are API Gateway's own and are asserted by status, not body bytes.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Malformed UTF-8/percent-escapes are still rejected with 400 once authenticated; an unauthenticated malformed request never reaches the handlers (401/403 first).

malformed_record_policy.details: Credentials never fail open: a missing, empty, scheme-less, or wrong-scheme Authorization value is denied (401 missing header, 403 otherwise), and token comparison is constant-time exact equality (hmac.compare_digest) so prefixes/superstrings are denied. Request-body policy is inherited unchanged from the decompose contract.

empty_input_semantics.details: Zero traffic is the estate's cheapest state, not an error: PAY_PER_REQUEST tables, no provisioned concurrency, and notBreaching alarms keep an idle estate silent at ~$0. An idle canary bake with no gate datapoints promotes (alarms stay OK via notBreaching). devin_webhook_url='' disables the incident destination cleanly (count=0).

trigger_granularity_note: Synchronous surface unchanged: one HTTP request = one authorizer decision (cached 300s per Authorization value) + one Lambda invocation. Incident loop granularity is one webhook POST per alarm state transition to ALARM (EventBridge matches the state-change event, not the steady state). Canary granularity is per deploy: one published version baked against the gate alarms per canary.py run.
